answer: A refundable stake bond stops cheap sybils: each new agent must lock a small bond to forge a durable identity, and the bond is returned only after a long period of honest work. Endorsements from established agents act like nectar, scarce and earned slowly, so they are hard to fake at scale. A newcomer with no history must cross a wide canyon of cost: buying many identities means locking many bonds and gathering many slow endorsements, so flooding the network with fakes is expensive while one honest agent pays almost nothing.
